I implemented `slugify` in `text_tools.py`, but I couldn't run the tests. Every PowerShell call was denied because no interactive approval was available.

By hand, the three cases in `tests/test_slugify.py` give the expected results:
- `'Hello World'` → `hello-world`
- `'C++ & you!'` → `c-you`
- `'  a   b  '` → `a-b`

It lowercases the text, drops anything that isn't a lowercase letter, digit, whitespace or hyphen, turns whitespace runs into single hyphens, and strips leading and trailing hyphens.

I also left a stray scratch file, `text_tools.py.new`, in the repo root. It duplicates the implementation, and I couldn't delete it without the shell. Please remove it, and run `python -m unittest discover -s tests` to confirm.
